data.name: Registered
data.value: Native source registered. The client owns acquisition, trust, and loading; managed policy and runtime overrides are not fully verifiable offline.

data.name: McpConfigured
data.value: Aspire MCP configuration is present. The client controls trust, policy, and server startup.

data.name: Disabled
data.value: An existing disabled choice was preserved; this entry was not enabled.

data.name: Conflict
data.value: An existing Aspire entry has a different source or command; it was not replaced.

data.name: ExistingMcpCustomization
data.value: Existing Aspire MCP settings in another applicable scope were preserved. No default entry was added that could override or broaden those customizations.

data.name: UnexpectedShape
data.value: The configuration has an unsupported JSON shape at '{0}'; this entry was left unchanged.

data.name: ObjectRequired
data.value: The configuration must contain a JSON object; the file was left unchanged.

data.name: MalformedJson
data.value: The configuration is not valid JSON/JSONC; the file was left unchanged.

data.name: ReadWriteFailed
data.value: Could not read or write the configuration: {0}

data.name: ConcurrentChange
data.value: The configuration or one of its overrides changed during setup. Retry after the other writer has finished.

data.name: UnsafeLink
data.value: The configuration link '{0}' could not be resolved safely; it was left unchanged.

data.name: PolicyBlocked
data.value: An existing policy or higher-precedence override controls this entry. It was preserved; review it in the client before enabling Aspire.

data.name: OpenCodeSchemaConflict
data.value: OpenCode version and configuration evidence do not establish one compatible V1 or V2 schema. Existing files were not converted.

data.name: OpenCodeCatalogVersionUnsupported
data.value: The detected OpenCode version ({0}) does not support skills.urls catalogs. Upgrade to OpenCode {1} or later; the catalog configuration was left unchanged.
data.comment: {0} is the detected client version; {1} is the minimum supported client version.

data.name: OpenCodeMultipleFiles
data.value: Multiple OpenCode configuration files apply at this scope. Consolidate them before configuring Aspire.

data.name: UnsupportedOverride
data.value: This client configuration override cannot be resolved safely offline. Configure this target in the client; no guessed path was written.

data.name: HookConfigured
data.value: The user-level Aspire usage hook is configured. Telemetry opt-out settings still apply.

data.name: HookNotApplicable
data.value: No selected supported client has a successfully configured Aspire skills or MCP target; no usage hook was added.

data.name: HookInstallationFailed
data.value: Could not prepare the embedded usage hook scripts: {0}

data.name: ExistingProjectHook
data.value: An existing project-level Aspire usage hook was preserved. No additional user hook was added, to avoid duplicate events.

data.name: ProfileLimitations
data.value: Aspire MCP configuration is present for this VS Code profile. Session-only --user-data-dir overrides and remote profiles must be configured in VS Code.
